conviction_note: The quarter was pre-released on 2026-10-02 (revenue $410-412m, adj EPS $0.55-0.59) together with a FY guide cut, so the 2026-10-21 print turns on 2027 framing (flood through Q2 2027, a refinancing that lifts interest cost near the top of 100-200bp, insurance offset, SurgiMend relaunch). The evidence is balanced: positives are a reset already taken (closed $12.68 on 10-02, now $13.37), strong Q3 operating cash flow and rising short interest (7.3M, 7.5 days to cover); negatives are the 2027 interest and flood headwinds and damaged credibility. So p_up is 50 and the scaled number is 0. The findings sum to +0.40, which is small and offsetting. abs_move is 10%, well below the name's ~16.5% median on genuine prints, because the quarter is pre-released and the guide was set 19 days ago.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue $410-412m and adj EPS $0.55-0.59, company pre-release 2026-10-02 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000917520/000091752026000067/ex991_q3pressreleasepreann.htm). FY2026 guide: revenue $1.634-1.654bn, adj EPS $2.30-2.40, OCF $190-200m (same document). Street Q3 adj EPS $0.56 from one source only (https://therighttrader.com/earnings-calendar/iart), possibly not updated after the pre-release. No post-cut 2027 consensus was found; TIKR's pre-cut 2027 figures (revenue $1.73bn, EPS $2.61 as of 2026-09-10, https://www.tikr.com/blog/integra-lifesciences-sinks-11-as-july-flooding-event-forces-guidance-cut-and-600-million-loan) are stale. The bar is company-guided for 2026 and unsourced for 2027, so the 2027-dependent finding is capped small.
positioning_check: FINRA short interest 7.3M shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, up from 6.8M on 09-15 and 6.2-6.5M in July; 7.5 days to cover; about 9.3% of shares outstanding (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/iart/short-interest/). This is moderately crowded and building into the print. It was about 9.3M at the April 2026 peak, ahead of the +24% reaction to Q1 on 2026-05-05. No usable option chain: the Nov-20 ATM spread is 174% of mid, ATM IV 103.5%, put/call OI 1.54 on 127 total contracts, and skew_25d is null, so the options market makes no usable directional statement. Tape: spot 13.365, 20-day run-up -16.6% (includes the 10-02 guide cut, -21.2% to a $12.68 close), 5-day -3.5%, 32.7% below the 52-week high and 50% above the 52-week low.

findings.finding: The refinancing that closed 2026-10-19 replaced a $1.3bn revolver and $775m term loan, both due March 2028, with a $600m revolver and $600m TLA (SOFR+300, 5-year), a $450m TLB (SOFR+425, 7-year, down from the $600m launched) and $450m of 9.500% senior secured notes due 2033. Management said on 10-09 the effective interest rate rises 'near the high end of the 100-200bp range'. On about $1.6bn of net debt that is roughly $30m a year pre-tax, about $0.30 a share, against a pre-cut 2027 EPS consensus of $2.61.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on interest cost. The 10-02 guide cut and $600m TLB launch together fell 21.2% (law-firm release citing the $12.68 close, https://www.newsfilecorp.com/release/317304). The stock has drifted down 3.5% over the 5 days since the 10-09 pricing 8-K.
findings.why_not_priced: The terms are public (8-Ks of 10-09 and 10-19), but the 2027 EPS consequence has no company number yet. If it were priced, the post-cut 2027 consensus would already sit well below $2.61; no updated figure was found. The Q3 call is where management frames 2027 interest expense. Financing question answered: the money refinances existing debt and pushes the maturity wall from 2028 to 2031-2033, which helps liquidity. It funds no ramp, and no covenant or going-concern flag was found. The sign is a modest EPS negative partly offset by lower refinancing risk.
findings.independence: The 10-09 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000917520/000119312526419228/d151933d8k.htm) is the same company and the same refinancing, so it is not independent. The Q2 release had already flagged 'higher interest rates and potential debt refinancing' as assumptions in the 2026 EPS guide (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000917520/000091752026000055/ex991-q22026earningsrelease.htm), so 2026 is mostly covered and the exposure is 2027.

findings.finding: Q3 is pre-released at revenue $410-412m (Q3 guide was $410-425m, so the bottom end) and adj EPS $0.55-0.59 (guide $0.53-0.61), with operating cash flow 'above $85m' in the quarter against a FY OCF guide of $190-200m. The one sourced street EPS figure is $0.56.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Integra beat EPS in 7 of its last 8 quarters (therighttrader). Beats were sold: Q2 2026 beat by $0.08 with the guide maintained and fell 16.55%; Q3 2025 fell 23.46%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: these are the company's own pre-released numbers and they sit inside the guide. The residual is the cash flow. Over $85m in one quarter is about 44% of the FY OCF guide, which points to Q4 deleveraging; little coverage has noted that. If it were priced, commentary would cite leverage falling from 4.1x despite the flood, and none was found.
findings.independence: None. This is the same document as the guide cut. The Q2 release gives leverage of 4.1x and liquidity of about $496m for context (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000917520/000091752026000055/ex991-q22026earningsrelease.htm).

findings.finding: Integra says its property and business-interruption insurance will offset 'a substantial portion of the earnings impact' of the Cincinnati flood (Q3 revenue -$7m, Q4 -$15-20m, full production back in Q2 2027). Claims were still being assessed, with no amount given on 10-02. The FY EPS cut was only $0.10 against a $22-27m revenue hit plus other assumption changes.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No precedent on this name. The flood disclosure itself (10-02) coincided with the -21.2% day.
findings.why_not_priced: No amount has been disclosed. If Q3 or the call quantifies a recognised or advanced business-interruption recovery, it shows how much of the 2027 flood drag (Q1-Q2 2027) is protected. Sized small because it is a one-off below or beside operating profit with no stated path to the guide; it can also disappoint if recoveries are deferred.
findings.independence: TIKR (https://www.tikr.com/blog/integra-lifesciences-sinks-11-as-july-flooding-event-forces-guidance-cut-and-600-million-loan) repeats the insurance claim from the same release, so it is not independent.

findings.finding: A law firm (Johnson Fistel) opened an investigation on 2026-10-04 into whether Integra's 2026-07-29 statement that the July flood would not materially affect 2026 guidance was misleading. That is a credibility overhang on management's Q2 2027 restart timeline and on any 2027 framing given on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (07-29): fell 16.55% on an EPS beat. The market already discounts this management's guidance heavily, with 4 of the last 7 genuine prints moving -16% to -23%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: this is routine plaintiff-firm activity after a guidance cut. The only residual is that it raises the bar for believing any new timeline on the call. Sized near 0.
findings.independence: Panabee's 10-02 summary also notes no immediate redundancy for the affected lines and customer-loss risk through the next two quarters (https://www.panabee.com/news/integra-lifesciences-earnings-q4-2026). That is AI-generated commentary, so weak.

findings.finding: Short interest rose into the print, to 7.3M shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement from 6.8M on 09-15 and 6.2M on 07-15 (about 9.3% of shares out, 7.5 days to cover). Shorts added after the guide reset, so a print that merely holds the 10-02 guide and gives no 2027 shock leaves a building short exposed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Short interest peaked near 9.3M in April 2026, and Q1 2026 (05-05) then rallied 24.13% on an EPS beat and raised guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public but carries no directional statement in a usable option chain (skew is null and OI tiny). If it were priced as a squeeze risk, borrow costs or call OI would show it, and OI is 127 contracts. The stock is already 5% off the 10-02 close of $12.68, so some covering may have happened since 09-30.
findings.independence: Equibles shows 6.5M / 8.3% of float / 5.9 days around 2026-08-19, consistent with the rising trend (https://equibles.com/stocks/IART).

outside_window.finding: Full Cincinnati manufacturing is restored only in Q2 2027, and SurgiMend contributes meaningfully only beyond 2026. Both are 2027 events, though call commentary on them lands in the window and is covered by the financing and insurance findings.

rejected_candidates.detail: Fully priced at the -21.2% close on 10-02, and the pre-released numbers are already filed as the reported-quarter finding.

baseline_tension: The baseline has no usable skew and its reaction history mixes in the non-earnings 10-02 cut. The -16.6% 20-day run-up is that cut itself. My evidence does not argue that the reset was too small or too large: rising short interest and strong cash flow lean up, the 2027 interest and flood headwinds lean down, and so it is balanced at p_up 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 4 (financing is a question): asked what the money buys. It refinances 2028 maturities and is not a ramp or distress, with no covenant or going-concern flag found. The financing finding shrank from -1.0 to -0.6 because the maturity extension partly offsets the interest step-up.
Lesson 6 (inside the guide; single-source bar): pre-released Q3 numbers sit inside the company's Q3 guide and the street EPS bar has one source, so that finding moved from +0.3 to +0.2.
Lesson 2 (one-offs): the insurance recovery has no stated path to the guide, so it moved from +0.4 to +0.2.
Lesson 3 (own caveat reaches the number): the class-action finding's own why_not_priced says it is largely priced, so it moved from -0.3 to -0.2.
Lesson 7 (positioning): 9.3% of shares out is moderate, not the 18-23% of the squeeze examples, and the stock is already 5% off its low, so the positioning finding moved from +1.0 to +0.8.
Lesson 8 (understatement) kept abs_move_pct at 10 rather than lower despite the pre-release; p_up was left at 50.
